title: Three permissions, three different jobs
dek: Start with the task your tool needs to do.

beats.title: Operate a control
beats.text: Accessibility lets a tool read or use the controls an app exposes.

beats.title: Capture the screen
beats.text: Screen & System Audio Recording covers capture access. It is separate from control access.

beats.title: Send app commands
beats.text: Automation covers Apple Events that let one app command another.

beats.title: Start with the task
beats.text: One workflow may need more than one permission. Check the requesting app; names vary by macOS version.

title: A click is not a completed task
dek: Observe the app. Act once. Check what changed.

beats.title: Observe
beats.text: Goal: save Weekend plans. Find the right window and the Save control.

beats.title: Act
beats.text: Press Save once. An accepted action does not prove the file was saved.

beats.title: Verify
beats.text: The app reports “Could not save”. The error means the goal is still unmet.

beats.title: Recover with a limit
beats.text: Inspect the cause before retrying. If one safe correction fails, stop and ask for help.

title: Snapping, tiling, and workspaces
dek: Three jobs that window tools can help with.

beats.title: Snap a window
beats.text: You choose the position. Put the selected window on the left.

beats.title: Tile automatically
beats.text: Rules arrange the windows. The layout adapts as a managed window joins.

beats.title: Group a workspace
beats.text: Keep related work together. Windows, projects, or sessions share a context.

beats.title: Choose the job
beats.text: Place one. Arrange several. Return to a context. Tools overlap; workspace behavior varies by app.
